keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Thomas Lemar (Elche).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Elche. Facundo Buonanotte replaces Thomas Lemar because of an injury.
Germán Valera (Elche) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Víctor Chust (Elche) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Valencia. Umar Sadiq replaces Pablo Maffeo.
Facundo Buonanotte (Elche) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Elche. Tete Morente replaces Germán Valera.
Substitution, Elche. Rubén Sánchez replaces Buba Sangaré.
Substitution, Elche. Abiel Osorio replaces Lucas Cepeda.
Goal! Elche 0, Valencia 1. Umar Sadiq (Valencia) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Arnaut Danjuma following a fast break.
Javi Guerra (Valencia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Valencia. Dani Raba replaces Luis Rioja.
Substitution, Valencia. Filip Ugrinic replaces Aaron Mayol.
Substitution, Elche. Grady Diangana replaces Javi Morcillo.
Delay in match because of an injury Dani Raba (Valencia).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Valencia. Jesús Vázquez replaces Arnaut Danjuma.
Substitution, Valencia. Mouctar Diakhaby replaces Javi Guerra.
Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Elche 0, Valencia 1.
